title: Enterprise Connectivity: invoice ceiling acceptance qualifying scope
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following eligibility and object boundaries for invoice ceiling acceptance.

## Scope clause 11
For invoice ceiling acceptance, for an assisted unbilled monthly transfer invoice, the customer personally files one authorization using their exact stated reference after the desk presents this ceiling.

## Scope clause 12
For invoice ceiling acceptance, network request status is pending and channel is portal; source classification is request.

## Scope clause 13
For invoice ceiling acceptance, the source event is the provider's whole-month internet outbound transfer export bundle, identified by the invoice assessment source-event reference.

## Scope clause 14
For invoice ceiling acceptance, this assisted route applies only to the uniquely identified unbilled source bundle whose interval tier matches the current holding tier and whose contract is on-demand with no approved negotiated rate.

## Scope clause 15
For invoice ceiling acceptance, its latest invoice assessment names that source bundle explicitly.

## Scope clause 16
For invoice ceiling acceptance, this invoice route requires selected export bundle to be the sole posted primary internet outbound transfer meter for its holding and UTC month, representing the entire month with the holding active throughout it; the full monthly allowance therefore belongs to that source.

## Scope clause 17
For invoice ceiling acceptance, its tier, commercial attributes, US East region and approved tax treatment must match the unchanged current holding attributes.

## Scope clause 18
For invoice ceiling acceptance, other monthly sources retain ordinary chronological allocation and are outside this assisted route.

## Scope clause 19
For invoice ceiling acceptance, the unsigned form for this route is the sole pending nonfinancial service record with source classification request, exact selected export bundle and related selected assessment, empty filing time and zero net service subtotal.

## Scope clause 20
For invoice ceiling acceptance, its identifier is available in the recorded evidence before signing.

## Scope clause 21
For invoice ceiling acceptance, it is a prepared form, not a filed customer request or authorization.

## Scope clause 22
For invoice ceiling acceptance, pass that identifier as request reference to the customer-owned filing action.

## Scope clause 23
For invoice ceiling acceptance, when the customer accepts the presented ceiling, update that same form into a customer request with source classification request, status pending, portal channel, the exact customer-stated external reference, the accepted net service subtotal, and filing time and occurrence time from the fixed current handling time; preserve its event identifier and return it in the actual filing receipt.

## Scope clause 24
For invoice ceiling acceptance, no accounting balance changes.

## Scope clause 25
For invoice ceiling acceptance, only the customer performs this filing; an unsigned form never supplies accepted net to pricing.
